title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
description:
Join to apply for the Accounts Receivable Specialist role at Enghouse Systems

About The Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Accounts Receivable Specialist to join our Finance team. This role is responsible for the end-to-end accounts receivable cycle, ensuring timely and accurate invoicing, efficient collections, and proper reconciliation of accounts. The ideal candidate will be experienced in managing client relationships, resolving billing discrepancies, and supporting month‑end close activities in a fast‑paced, international environment. This is a remote position open to candidates based in Brazil, reporting to the Accounts Receivable Supervisor.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare, issue, and record invoices accurately and in a timely manner.
  • Manage collections, proactively following up with clients to ensure payments are received within agreed terms.
  • Record and apply customer payments in the financial/ERP system, ensuring accuracy and compliance with internal policies.
  • Maintain and reconcile AR sub‑ledgers, intercompany accounts, and assigned balance sheet accounts.
  • Analyze and resolve account discrepancies by collaborating with sales, operations, and other internal teams.
  • Prepare and maintain accurate aging reports and collection status summaries.
  • Assist in the month‑end close process, including journal entries and account reconciliations.
  • Support internal and external audits by providing required documentation and reports.
  • Perform light general accounting duties and assist with other finance tasks as needed.
  • Participate in continuous process improvement and cross‑training initiatives.
  • Build and maintain cooperative working relationships with both internal stakeholders and external clients.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Technical or university degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 2–3 years of hands‑on experience in Accounts Receivable, Billing, or Collections, preferably with direct customer contact.
  • Solid understanding of accounting principles, bank reconciliations, and general ledger processes.
  • Experience with ERP or financial systems.
  • Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Word.
  • Basic knowledge of Accounts Payable processes is an advantage.
  • Spanish: Fluent; English: Intermediate level required.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Strong communication and customer service skills, with a professional and courteous approach.
  • Excellent organizational and time‑management abilities; able to handle high volumes and prioritize effectively.
  • Analytical and problem‑solving mindset, able to investigate and resolve discrepancies efficiently.
  • Proactive, results‑oriented, and adaptable to changing priorities.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
  • Team player with a willingness to learn and contribute to a multicultural, collaborative work culture.

About Enghouse

Enghouse Systems Limited is a leading Canadian software and services company (TSX: ENGH) driving innovation in remote work, visual computing, and next‑generation communications. We empower organizations around the world with software‑defined networking and customer experience solutions.

Join us in shaping the future of enterprise software while working in a dynamic, global, and inclusive environment.

Overview

O time de Engenharia de Dados da Incognia é responsável por melhorar e manter toda a infraestrutura de dados da empresa, desde clusters, serviços de dados e autenticação, até ETLs, notebooks e outras ferramentas necessárias que permitem que nossos colaboradores possam extrair métricas e inteligência de um vasto volume de dados ingeridos diariamente, de forma fácil, confiável, segura e respeitando a privacidade dos nossos usuários. O trabalho do time é essencial para entregar uma variedade de soluções baseadas em um grande volume de dados coletados, com o objetivo de proteger usuários de diversos clientes de golpes e fraude.

A oportunidade

Precisamos de uma pessoa que tenha familiaridade com vários bancos de dados e engines de processamento distribuído, que consiga entender a fundo as ferramentas que usamos e que, em caso necessário, seja capaz de contribuir para os projetos open source que rodamos em produção ou possa criar nossas próprias soluções para vencer nossos desafios de dados.

  • Criar, implantar, manter e monitorar soluções de infraestrutura de dados para toda a empresa, incluindo deployments de ferramentas open source e soluções desenvolvidas internamente;
  • Prover ferramentas como software, guidelines e templates que tornem o uso da infraestrutura de dados fluida e de fácil acesso aos colaboradores;
  • Criar e manter pipelines de dados recorrentes e/ou em tempo real de alta performance para tratar grandes volumes de dados;
  • Monitorar constantemente nossos sistemas para garantir alta disponibilidade, performance e redução de custos;
  • Criar mecanismos que garantam as políticas de acesso aos dados;

  • Experiência com ETLs/Pipelines em larga escala;

  • Familiaridade com vários bancos de dados;

Sobre a Incognia

A Incognia é a empresa inovadora em soluções de identidade de última geração que possibilitam experiências digitais seguras e sem fricção. Com sua solução persistente de identificação de dispositivos, a Incognia combina sinais de reconhecimento de dispositivo de excelência e à prova de adulteração e análise de localização para verificação de usuários e prevenção de fraudes. Para mais informações, visite Incognia.com/pt.

Primeiramente, valorizamos muito a nossa cultura. Nossa equipe compartilha os valores de Ambição, Excelência e Confiança, seja em relação aos nossos usuários, clientes ou membros da equipe. A Incognia também se abstém de fazer pronunciamentos institucionais sobre temas não diretamente relacionados com a sua atividade e missão. Além disso, levamos muito a sério nosso desempenho. Por isso, oferecemos suporte através de nosso processo de onboarding, feedback frequentes com a liderança, ciclos de avaliação, feedback contínuo de colegas e as ferramentas certas para o seu desenvolvimento. title: Partner Development Specialist - Affiliate Marketing
description:
Who We Are

PartnerCentric is a leader in affiliate and partner marketing, leveraging innovative technology and personalized strategies to help brands grow revenue and drive unparalleled value. As a people-first company, we prioritize diversity in thought, experience, and background to foster an inclusive, collaborative culture. Our vision is to set the gold standard in partner marketing through proprietary technology and world-class client support.

We support remote work styles for anyone legally eligible to work in the U.S.

Position Overview

The Partner Development Specialist is an entry-level role supporting the growth and success of PartnerCentric\'s Partnership Development Center of Excellence. This role focuses on researching, recruiting, onboarding, and nurturing high-value affiliate and partnership opportunities to help drive performance and revenue growth for our clients.

This position is an excellent opportunity for someone with a sales hunter mindset—energized by outreach, motivated by goals, and excited to pursue new relationships. If you thrive on proactive communication, love the challenge of opening new doors, and enjoy laying the foundation for long-term success, this is the role for you.

As a key player within the Partnerships team, the Specialist will collaborate closely with senior team members and cross-functional departments to support the success of strategic partner relationships, manage administrative and reporting tasks, and contribute to PartnerCentric\'s reputation as a leader in the affiliate marketing space.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone looking to build a career in digital marketing and partnerships with an added passion for sales development and partner acquisition.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Partner Recruitment & Support
    • Proactively identify and pursue prospective partners aligned with client goals, leveraging PartnerCentric\'s internal technology tools to support data-driven partner sourcing and prioritization.
    • Craft and send engaging outreach communications that reflect a sales-driven mindset.
    • Assist in the onboarding process for new partners, ensuring a smooth setup and integration experience.
    • Focus on activating newly onboarded partners and driving early-stage productivity within client programs to accelerate value generation.
    • Maintain detailed records of partner outreach, statuses, and relationship notes in internal systems.
    • Strategic growth mindset as it relates to scaling high-performing partners across other programs.
  2. Administrative and Relationship Support
    • Manage and update partner databases to ensure accurate tracking of communications, agreements, and performance.
    • Support the Partnerships team by scheduling meetings, preparing materials, and compiling reports that partners can access.
    • Assist in managing partner communications, such as newsletters, updates, and promotional opportunities.
  3. Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Work with internal teams including Client Services, Marketing, and Technology to support partnership activation and education initiatives.
    • Help organize internal training sessions and contribute to the creation of partner resource materials and case studies.
    • Research AI tools to better support the team in the most efficient way.
  4. Performance Tracking & Reporting
    • Monitor new partner performance metrics and assist in compiling regular performance summaries and insights for internal use.
    • Use tracking platforms to pull data and provide basic analysis that supports decision-making and partner optimization.

A Week in the Life: Partner Development Specialist

  1. Monday: Join the weekly Partnerships team huddle; review and prioritize partner outreach and onboarding tasks.
  2. Tuesday: Research potential new partners for a client campaign and initiate strategic outreach with senior guidance.
  3. Wednesday: Assist in compiling a partner performance report for a client business review.
  4. Thursday: Join weekly client calls to discuss new partner opportunities and provide feedback.
  5. Friday: Attend an internal training session on a new partner platform integration; update the partner contact database and reflect on learnings for the week & review progress towards quarterly goals and report via Metronome.

Qualifications

  • 1-2 years of experience in digital marketing, affiliate marketing, partnerships, sales, or a related field (internships and entry-level experience welcome).
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Curiosity and willingness to learn about the affiliate, influencer, and content commerce ecosystems.
  • Comfortable working with spreadsheets, CRM systems, and affiliate tracking platforms (prior experience is a plus, but not required).
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and collaborative work style in a remote environment.
  • Natural inclination toward sales-oriented tasks like outreach, lead generation, and relationship-building.

Preferred Attributes

  • Experience with partner management tools (e.g., Impact, Partnerize, Rakuten, ShareASale) is a bonus.
  • Interest in digital marketing, e-commerce, and partnership strategy.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment with a strong focus on client outcomes.
  • Enthusiasm for supporting diverse client verticals and innovative marketing strategies.
  • Enjoys the challenge of finding and engaging new partners to help drive mutual business growth.
